The plate looks like a square side plate of about 24 cm, which spans roughly 345 px in the image. That gives about 0.07 cm per px.

The apple is about 128 px wide, so roughly 9 cm across by this scale. That is a bit large, so I'd put it nearer 8 cm, which is a medium-to-large apple.

An apple 8 cm across weighs about 200 g. Apples run about 52 kcal per 100 g, so that comes to roughly 105 kcal.
